notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/908349b0934b3cc7c76b7df29c518cc0253cf4f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/4c6e4d74ed0f01b5094b4b7beadc09bcc481602a.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes for Update 1.1.3[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/bf397498112763de55a5271c9789d8f3215f52d1.png[/img]
[*]You can now mark formulas visually. You need to pick them up to be able to mark them. You can also mark the ones on the board while you having your cursor on them. (default button Q). You can change this in the controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/45f1cd01b8bb507be50e8c22d6b33cf820ba032f.png[/img]
[*]Added green arrows which point to specific equipment when carrying an ingredient. If you are carrying a key, the arrow will point to the Antidote Producer. If you carry a messed up ingredient "?!?!?" the arrow will point to The Reverter. This can be turned off in the main menu and does not affect difficulty.

[*]Formulas are now a little bit more easier to read
[*]You can now move objects a bit further and closer with mouse scroll
[*]Changed speed of ingredient when putting it in Code combiner
[*]Equipment now has additional green or red FX when the player interacts with it
[*]Chemical Processor now spawns the finished ingredient more closer to the player
[*]Fixed a bug which caused Ingredients to fully disappear when taking them out of Chemical Processor and some other cases.
[*]Added the possibility of [b]crouching[/b]! You can now crouch using the button C (Default) - let me know what are your thoughts on this!
[*]Updated some translations for languages used in-game
[*]A lot of tutorial changes and improvements which should help players get the core of the game
[*]The "Turkish I" problem should now be fixed, this is related to players which System language is Turkish, and are playing with English language selected
[*]The formula objects won't push the player if the player looks down when carrying the formula
[*]Resized some texts in the pause menu to better fit the UI
[*]Some objects have been removed from some laboratories and some added
[*]Some objects have had their positions fixed
[*]Gravity should no longer bug out in some cases, making the player float in the laboratory
[*]Added grayscale effect when you lose
[*]In stats view, for the win loss ratios in the text, the decimals now get trimmed
[*]Fixed an issue where there were no formulas to be found on some laboratories
[*]Improved lighting in Laboratory 2
[*]Fixed some UI issues when on different resolutions such as 1280x600
[*]Re-baked lighting in all levels
[*]Fixed some positions for laboratory equipment in some laboratories
[*]Added a door to laboratory 5 and 6! No more claustrophobia!
[*]Added 6 new achievements for you to unlock!
[*]Added sound effect when the player picks up all formulas, and when the player picks up all the ingredients. Also when you pick up the blue orb!
[*]Centered the pivot of most objects
[*]Achievements are now no longer unlockable when in tutorial
[*]Added black screen fade when quitting game
[*]Reduced the mass of ingredients
[*]Fixed some other smaller issues
[/list]

Join discord!

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/4542a9ebcc03d28651912657f27c3da9b458ec43.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes for Update 1.0.8[/h1]
[list]
- Settings in the main menu are now reworked under the hood and changing the resolution doesn't take more clicks than one! You might notice some other changes in this menu.
- Added Croissant powerup. After you have eaten a croissant, you can go and pick up an object and enlarge it!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/4dd6e781d0fa826e3e6be5be84467126795cadf9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/44a304d5c46984c6fec90b650a5b6936f2499759.png[/img][/url]
- You can now make your own difficulty setting and save it so you can use it whenever you want to!
- Fixed some equipment positions in Laboratory 1
- Changed a bit on how close objects are to the player when carrying them
- Fixed water visuals when pouring water in laboratory 2
- Selecting custom difficulty now doesn't change any values, for example you can now select crazy difficulty, and then select custom difficulty, and start modifying the difficulty to suit your own custom wishes! :)
- Various smaller main menu visual improvements :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/44c46fef3ef669d85f7bcf089bfeceee12ddb362.png[/img]
- Each laboratory now has three blue orb pickups, finding all three will award you an achievement! Find all pickups in all laboratories will also award an achievement. :)
- Added two new variants of flasks. :)
- Added 6 new Steam Achievements!
- Added a new Laboratory for you to check out... well it's actually a kitchen with a living room, but it's just as fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/edbad898471d30d5e3bea04a3310cc589fcdef0d.png[/img]
- Added some new points where ingredients can spawn!
- Added and fixed some shrink curves!
- Depth of Field effect changes it's focus depending on... well what's in focus! (when enabled)
- Some smaller changes under the hood to make the feel of the game better

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/679a3df6ce0a176b3b0e4e009758de7f14565374.png[/img]

[u]First of all, sorry for taking so long to get the new update out! Please have fun and enjoy![/u]

[h1]Patch notes for Update 1.0.6[/h1]
[list]
[*]Progress over equipment is now colored green/red depending on how you mixed the ingredients - the ingredients also receive a differently colored outline.
[*]Drawers & Cabinets in Laboratory 1 now open & close much faster!
[*]There is now a notification when a key to an antidote has been produced!
[*]Changed some sound effects for the laboratory equipment
[*]Added a toggle in the play menu (doesn't affect difficulty) for floating text over each equipment so new players can get into the game easier!

[*][b]Beginner difficulty added[/b]!
[*]This difficulty outlines all ingredients at the start as well as all formulas
[*]Not harsh on the player :)
[*]All ingredients remain outlined & have their names visible throughout the round
[*]Achievement for beating this difficulty added! :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/410d01f6ceb1849710f20ec86920d8010aace864.png[/img]
[*]Changed the min value and max value for mouse sensitivity in the main menu
[*]You can now also change mouse sensitivity while in-game in the pause menu
[*]Breakable ingredients: now they actually shatter even if you carry them and hit them!
[*]Added a few new "Shrink Curves" (Animation Curves for decreasing height) - feel free to experiment and suggest new ones!
[*] You can now toggle ON or OFF the pulsating effect which activates when there's less than 1 minute left in the main menu (does not affect difficulty)!
[*] Increased throwing force of the player. You're stronger now!
[*] It is now easier to break the security camera in Laboratory 1!
[*] Added ticking sound once you're down to 1 minute! Tick-tock, more drama!
[*] Fixed ingredients audio, ingredients should now clink more & better :)
[*] Added [b]a lot[/b] of new ingredient names and now there are over [b]200 unique names[/b] for ingredients. :D 
[*] Fixed some spawn points for flasks in Laboratory 2
[*] Readjusted some min & max values for sliders in the play menu!
[*] Readjusted some difficulty settings
[*] Readjusted lights and lighting settings on Lab1, Lab2 and Lab3!
[*] [b]Drastically [/b]improved shadows quality!
[*] Added new sound effects for various items around Lab1 and Lab2!
[*]A lot of under the hood changes, player should now feel a bit different, let me know what you think!
[*] BUGFIX: Pulsating effect now stops when the round has ended
[*] BUGFIX: You can no longer insert keys into Chemical Processor, Code Combiner and Microwave.

[*] You can now enter your [b]custom ingredient names[/b] in the play menu (open up the special view with the button on the third page!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/c8c8cd06f69bf895102d910d1049ded71f201a00.png[/img]

[*]Laboratory 1
[*] new lightning!
[*]Laboratory 2
[*] new lightning!
[*] drastically changed the layout and added new stuff!
[*] Laboratory 3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/0941e298187743fd790ebbea9f6a2d8967399746.png[/img]
[*] added completely new Laboratory 3! This one is the biggest one yet, full of new props! Explore it and let me know what you think and what could be improved!

[*]Added achievements:
[*]Complete a round on beginner difficulty! Baby Steps!
[*]Save yourself without having to use the Reverter!
[*] When breakable flasks are enabled, break at least one at very high speed!
[*]Destroy the TV!
[/list]

-- Tell me, what are your thoughts on Size Matters, and what would you like to see in the future updates? :)

⭐️[b]PLEASE leave a review on Steam if you like Size Matters! It would help me so much![/b] ⚗️🔬
⭐️More good stuff is on the way everyone! 🙊
⭐️Join discord here: https://discord.gg/rHFbwMz  👌🏼 ✔️

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/648bca719457fc374a299c2fd06089b00f2872d7.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes for Update 1.0.5[/h1]
[list]
[*]Modified & optimized particles for each equipment
[*]The liquid inside flasks now looks and feels like a real liquid!
[*]Same applies for the equipment, now there is liquid inside! Woohoo!
[*] EXPERIMENTAL :: You can now spill your ingredients! If you spill too much of the ingredient out of its container, it shatters! Of course, you can get it back at the Restorer. This is toggleable in the play menu. If you don't like it, you can disable it. This is experimental so expect changes and some bugs may occur when this is enabled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33886820/e0705ca1cef9823e03b06a4c87f9816c900ed100.gif[/img]
[*] Once you've inserted all three keys into the Antidote Mixer, the antidote creation starts by itself now!
[*] Added counters which help you by showing the count of found ingredients and found formulas in the top left corner! They turn green once you've found them all!
[*] Added new notifications for important events, with fancier animations!
[*] Improved particle effects when a flask is shattered
[*] Changed the play menu so there is less clutter and and more place for new features! :) You can now navigate between the two tabs in the main menu now!
[*] Added time left notifications! When you reach 10, 5, 3 and 1 minutes, there's a message on the screen warning you :)
[*] Modified cabinets in Laboratory 2 so it's a bit more "open" & easier to find stuff without needing to open every single damn cabinet!
[*] It is now much easier to carry items when you're smaller (it happened to be near impossible before)
[*] Modified & added some new flask & formula spawn locations in laboratories
[*] Fixed an issue with Randomize Equipment Placement in Laboratory 2! This should work now as expected
[*] Added confetti to the game winning screen! Woohoo! 
[/list]

⭐️[b]PLEASE leave a review on Steam if you like Size Matters! It would help me so much![/b] ⚗️🔬
⭐️More good stuff is on the way everyone! 🙊
⭐️Join discord here: https://discord.gg/rHFbwMz  👌🏼 ✔️
